mapper.select: SELECT id,name,email,role,status,created_at FROM admin_users deleted_at IS NULL AND (name ILIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR email ILIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM admin_users deleted_at IS NULL AND (name ILIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR email ILIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))
SELECT id,name,email,role,status,created_at FROM admin_users WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM admin_users WHERE email=#{email} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND id != #{excludeId}
mapper.update: UPDATE admin_users SET deleted_at=now(), status='INACTIVE' WHERE id=#{id}
